run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum length subsequence where adjacent element differences are 0 or 1
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify correct maximum length subsequence results
review_f_gold: review f_gold dynamic programming approach for finding longest subsequence with adjacent difference at most 1
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid shadowing the built-in max variable and improve readability
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes the maximum length subsequence using O(n^2) dynamic programming
